voice.title.description: Heading and document title of the list of the open voice chat rooms, and its item in the main navigation.

voice.unavailable.defaultMessage: This server does not offer voice chat.
voice.unavailable.description: Shown on the voice chat pages when the server has voice chat turned off.

voice.list.label.description: Accessible name of the list of the open voice chat rooms.

voice.list.empty.defaultMessage: No rooms are open right now
voice.list.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.empty.description.defaultMessage: Rooms that you can join show up here while they are open.
voice.list.empty.description.description: Explanation under the heading of the empty list of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the voice chat rooms load.

voice.list.failed.description: Heading of the error when the voice chat rooms could not load.

voice.list.retry.description: Button that loads the voice chat rooms again after a failure.

voice.list.more.description: Button that loads the next page of voice chat rooms.

voice.list.more_failed.description: Error when the next page of voice chat rooms could not load.

voice.room.participants_count.description: How many people are in a voice chat room, the host included.

voice.room.hosted_by.description: Label before the host of a voice chat room in the room's card.

voice.rail.title.description: Heading of the panel of open voice chat rooms in the third column of wide screens.

voice.rail.all.description: Link from the panel of voice chat rooms to the list of all open rooms.

voice.tag.title.description: Heading of the open voice chat rooms with a hashtag, at the top of the hashtag's page. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

voice.start.description: Button on the voice chat page that opens the form to start a new room.

voice.form.new_title.description: Title of the dialog with the form that starts a new voice chat room.

voice.form.edit_title.description: Title of the dialog with the settings of a voice chat room, and the host's button that opens it.

voice.form.close.description: Accessible name of the close button of the dialog of a voice chat room's settings.

voice.form.name.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's name.

voice.form.name.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a name of up to {max} characters on one line.
voice.form.name.invalid.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's name. {max} is the most characters it takes.

voice.form.description.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's description.

voice.form.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
voice.form.characters_left.description: How many more characters the description of a voice chat room takes.

voice.form.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character over} other {# characters over}}
voice.form.characters_over.description: How many characters the description of a voice chat room is over its limit.

voice.form.hashtags.description: Label of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags.

voice.form.hashtags.description.defaultMessage: Up to {max}, separated by spaces. The room shows on the pages of its hashtags.
voice.form.hashtags.description.description: Explanation of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags. {max} is how many it takes.

voice.form.hashtags.invalid.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags. {max} is how many it takes.

voice.form.hashtags.too_long.defaultMessage: Each hashtag can have up to {max} characters.
voice.form.hashtags.too_long.description: Error of the field of a voice chat room's hashtags when one is too long. {max} is the most characters a hashtag has.

voice.form.visibility.description: Label of the choice of who sees a voice chat room and may join it.

voice.form.speakers.description: Label of the choice of who may speak in a voice chat room without the hosts letting them.

voice.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: every local user.

voice.visibility.followers.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: the followers of its host.

voice.visibility.mutuals.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: those who follow the host and whom the host follows.

voice.visibility.invited.description: Visibility of a voice chat room: only the people the hosts invite.

voice.speakers.everyone.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: everyone in it.

voice.speakers.followers.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: the followers of the host.

voice.speakers.mutuals.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: the host's mutual follows.

voice.speakers.manual.defaultMessage: Only people the hosts let speak
voice.speakers.manual.description: Who may speak in a voice chat room without asking: nobody, the host and the co-hosts let them.

voice.form.post.description: Switch in the form that starts a voice chat room: also post a post that links the room.

voice.form.post.local.defaultMessage: A local post, visible to everyone on this server.
voice.form.post.local.description: Explanation of the start post of a room for every local user.

voice.form.post.followers.defaultMessage: A post for your followers only.
voice.form.post.followers.description: Explanation of the start post of a room for the host's followers.

voice.form.post.text.description: Label of the text of the post that announces a new voice chat room.

voice.form.post.text.description.defaultMessage: The link to the room is added at the end.
voice.form.post.text.description.description: Explanation of the text of the post that announces a new voice chat room.

voice.form.post.draft.defaultMessage: I opened a voice chat room: {name}
voice.form.post.draft.description: The draft text of the post that announces a new voice chat room, which the host edits. {name} is the room's name.

voice.form.submit_new.description: Button that starts a new voice chat room.

voice.form.submit_edit.description: Button that saves the settings of a voice chat room.

voice.form.start_failed.description: Error when a voice chat room could not start. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.form.save_failed.description: Error when the settings of a voice chat room could not be saved. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.form.saved.description: Message after the settings of a voice chat room were saved.

voice.room.title.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room whose name is not shown.

voice.room.listed_notice.defaultMessage: When you join, your name is listed for everyone who can see this room.
voice.room.listed_notice.description: Notice on the page of a voice chat room before joining it.

voice.room.join.description: Button that joins a voice chat room.

voice.room.join_failed.description: Error when joining a voice chat room failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

voice.room.joined.description: Shown on the page of a voice chat room that the user is in.

voice.room.participants.description: Heading of the list of the people in a voice chat room.

voice.room.details.description: Accessible name of the list of a voice chat room's settings on its page.

voice.role.host.description: Label of the host of a voice chat room in its list of participants.

voice.role.cohost.description: Label of a co-host of a voice chat room in its list of participants.

voice.role.speaker.description: Label of a participant of a voice chat room who speaks.

voice.role.listener.description: Label of a participant of a voice chat room who listens.

voice.room.local_only.defaultMessage: Only people with an account on this server can join its voice chat rooms.
voice.room.local_only.description: Notice on the page of a voice chat room for a visitor who is not signed in.

voice.room.sign_in.description: Link on the page of a voice chat room to the sign-in page, which returns to the room.

voice.room.open.description: Shown on the summary of an open voice chat room to a visitor who is not signed in.

voice.room.ended.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room that ended.

voice.room.hidden.description: Shown on the page of an open voice chat room that the user may not see.

voice.room.not_found.description: Heading of the page of a voice chat room that does not exist.

voice.room.failed.description: Heading of the error when a voice chat room could not load.

voice.room.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while a voice chat room loads.

voice.profile.host.defaultMessage: {name} is hosting a voice chat room: {room}
voice.profile.host.description: Note on a profile while the account hosts an open voice chat room. {name} is the account's name, {room} the room's name as a link.

voice.profile.speaker.defaultMessage: {name} is speaking in a voice chat room: {room}
voice.profile.speaker.description: Note on a profile while the account speaks in an open voice chat room. {name} is the account's name, {room} the room's name as a link.

voice.history.title.description: Heading of the settings page with the voice chat rooms the user hosted, and its item in the settings menu.

voice.history.description.defaultMessage: The voice chat rooms you hosted, newest first.
voice.history.description.description: Explanation at the top of the voice chat history.

voice.history.empty.defaultMessage: You haven't hosted a room yet
voice.history.empty.description: Heading of the empty voice chat history.

voice.history.opened.description: Term of when a room of the voice chat history opened.

voice.history.ended.description: Term of when a room of the voice chat history ended.

voice.history.still_open.description: Value of when a room of the voice chat history ended, while it is open.

voice.history.reason.description: Term of why a room of the voice chat history ended.

voice.end_reason.host.description: Why a voice chat room ended: its host ended it.

voice.end_reason.empty.description: Why a voice chat room ended: nobody was left.

voice.end_reason.host_disconnected.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the host was disconnected and nobody could take over.

voice.end_reason.host_ineligible.defaultMessage: The host could no longer host it
voice.end_reason.host_ineligible.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the host lost the right to host and nobody could take over.

voice.end_reason.moderator.description: Why a voice chat room ended: a moderator ended it.

voice.end_reason.time_limit.description: Why a voice chat room ended: it was open for the longest time the server allows.

voice.end_reason.disabled.description: Why a voice chat room ended: the server turned voice chat off.

voice.end_reason.other.description: Why a voice chat room ended, for a reason the app does not know.
